Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: After confirming via reliable sources that Kitiyakara Voralaksana is the paternal grandfather (explicitly of Queen Sirikit and therefore also of her sister Busba), the Planner incorrectly concluded the grandfather was Prince Bhanurangsi Savangwongse and even misattributed the “1st Prince of Chanthaburi” title. This contradicts the verified evidence and reflects a synthesis error/confusion of individuals and titles.
